<p>Originally from Taiwan, now based in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania. I do my doctoral research in Civil &amp; Environmental Engineering at Lehigh University, in the Complex Adaptive Water Systems Lab. I began with empirical human behavior and human–water systems: survey design, psychometrics, and coupled flood-risk simulation. That foundation now informs how I evaluate generated behavior and design constraint-checked agent systems.</p>

<h3>Research</h3>
<p><b>How do people decide under flood risk, and what do those decisions change?</b></p>
